about:
Complete MetalCraft LLC operates from Highland, Michigan, serving clients across the United States. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials. It presents itself as a prototype and short-run production manufacturer specializing in metal fabrication, stamping, laser cutting, welding, and CNC machining.

The shop offers precision metal fabrication, prototype and short-run stamping up to 600 tons, flat and 5‑axis laser cutting for material up to 1.5 inches thick, MIG/TIG/spot welding, and CNC machining on a Bridgeport VMC 4020. It emphasizes the ability to handle multiple processes under one roof, which reduces turnaround time and cost for customers. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Complete MetalCraft serves automotive Tier I and II suppliers, military and defense programs, and alternative‑energy projects. The company cites these sectors as its primary markets but does not name specific customers.

The company states that its differentiators include personalized service, competitive pricing, attention to detail, and receptiveness to unique client needs. It was built on the idea that consolidating fabrication processes in a single shop improves operational efficiency for its clients.
